_doc: list_dispatch.py's settings: the Workshop Pipeline's Waiting, Ready and Work stages (item RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_LIST_LANE_ON_RED_DISPATCH_GOALS_FIRST; plan design/specs/2026-11-22-coordination-every-agent-must-use/plan.md step 2; page design/specs/2026-11-23-list-dispatch/boundary.md). One detached helper per open list item whose outcome check fails; the check runs again before every attempt; at most two Work runs per item.
_max_live_doc: Starvation: list work and mod work each keep their own slots, so a burst of one does not drop the other (plan.md §Shares; 25 list debts sat untouched over a day while mods ran). These slots are the lane's at any load. Live detached runs on lane items, hand launches included; mod and nightly-test runs are not counted, and the mod tick does not count the lane's (2026-11-24 it did: lane runs on FlowWorks held the Gimme Some Slack walk brief at slots_full from 7:24 to 8:02 AM PST).
_hosts_hold: max_live 0 since 2026-11-25 12:40 AM PST, by the owner's word: no new work goes to SteveDesktop until its repo clones are on its SSD (RIMMANDRAKE_MOVE_STEVEDESKTOP_CLONES_TO_SSD_LINUX_DRIVE_SITS_ON_HARD_DISK). Its Linux drive sits on a hard disk; one publish stalled the disk 60%. Put 6 back when that item closes.
_hosts_doc: Starved games: SteveDesktop (18 cores, 62 GB for WSL) also runs the two test-lane games Steve1 and Steve2, so at most max_live lane runs live there; they are placed only when the lane's own slots here are full (run_host.py, RIMMANDRAKE_FINISH_STEVE_HOST_LAUNCH_NEVER_RAN_ON_REAL_MACHINE). Spent account: only while the host's live account has more than min_left_pct of the week left (owner by card 2026-11-24: 'Use Steve down to 5% left').
_load_line_doc: Machine load: at load average 50 on 14 cores with ten runs live, timing tests read false reds (2026-11-23 3:46 AM PST, maturation_dispatch.json _max_live_doc, whose line is the same 28). Past max_live the lane launches only while the larger of the 1 and 5 minute load averages, plus load_per_run for each launch of this tick and each recent lane launch, is under this line.
_load_per_run_doc: A burst that the load average cannot see yet: a launch raises the load only minutes later, so one tick at a low load could start every ready item. Measured 2026-11-24 8:17 AM PST: load 14 with 8 live runs, 1.75 each, rounded up.
_load_lag_s_doc: A dip can admit work before even the 1-minute average reflects the launches, and the 5-minute average can decide spare room. Reserve load for five minutes after a live lane run launches. At 10:46 AM PST on 2026-11-24 one dip left 10 lane runs live for 2 slots and load at 42.5.
_max_runs_per_item_doc: A chain that feeds itself: the retired Relentless churned items through rerun after rerun (2026-11-05); the owner's condition of 2026-11-14 is no automatic loops. A second run only on the first run's named next act.
_max_chain_depth_doc: A chain that feeds itself through new items: a lane run that files an item that the lane then works. An item whose caused_by ancestors already hold this many lane runs is not launched (plan.md §Shares).
_max_never_started_doc: A launch that cannot start, sent again unchanged on every tick (CLAUDE.md §A fault of form: a program never sends the same refused input again unchanged). Never-started launches in a row before the item reads stopped.
_max_adopt_check_s_doc: A heavy check run on every beat of two timers (list_effect every 15 min, this lane every 10): measured 2026-11-23, modledger_cutover_accept.py ran over 3 min and took this unit to its 2 GB cap. An acceptance script that does not end inside this bound is not attached as a check. Also the hang guard of that one timing run.
_sonnet_cap_usd_doc: Runaway spend by one helper, stopped from outside by spend_watchdog (detached_helper --budget-usd); the brief never states it. Same as red_dispatch.json.
_opus_cap_usd_doc: Runaway spend by one helper, stopped from outside by spend_watchdog; the brief never states it. Same as red_dispatch.json.
_sonnet_if_doc: Ladder (infrastructure/agents/Agent_Policy.md): sonnet for well-defined coding a test proves; the item's check is that test when it runs a selftest or an acceptance script. Every other check (a path check on prose, a study) gets opus.
_shape_from_doc: A flood of Shape runs on old items: 1,457 open items carried no outcome check on 2026-11-23 (measured), and the plan does no hand migration of old items. An item filed before this moment enters Shape only when someone names it (`rimflow shape <ID> --enter`); one filed at or after it enters by itself after shape_grace_h. Empty: no item enters by itself.
_shape_grace_h: danger=a Shape run is spent on an item that its filer is about to close or claim; ends no work: the item is due for Shape
_shape_grace_h_doc: A Shape run spent on an item that its filer is about to close or claim. Measured 2026-11-23 over the 385 items filed with no check and closed in the 3 days before: 52% closed inside 1 h, 75% inside 6 h, 88% inside 24 h.
